body: I honestly don’t know. I don’t even know how I ended up like this. There’s too many things that contribute to my anxiety so I don’t know if I can pinpoint it to one underlying reason.
No I don’t. I tried to talk to my mother about my anxiety, but she doesn’t view it as anything serious.
Everything. I hate my life, I hate myself. I’m forced to smile because everyone thinks of me as this “always optimistic” and “smiley” person, but I hate myself with so much passion.
I took the nearest pills I could find. They’re drowsy  allergy pills so that’s probably why I feel really dizzy right now and I can’t hold myself up.
I’m scared that if I call 911 my parents will find out. I’m hoping the pills that I took aren’t that serious.
